assignment_source: Project-owner directive of 2026-10-31: 'Work on your own to complete tasks... keep iterating and testing until we have the highest scoring submission'. The lane is assigned here explicitly so the protocol's single-method-paragraph gate is satisfied; it is recorded, not self-invented in secret.
method_paragraph: Using the hash-verified owner-mirrored 19-band geophysical stack on the organizer grid (EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, 100 m), build a label-free concordance surface: for each of six physically independent fields (rtp magnetics b2, total-count radiometrics b6, isostatic gravity b13, conductive-base depth b15, conductivity surface b17, detrended elevation slope b19) compute ridge magnitude |grad(G_sigma * band)| at sigma=1.5 px and sigma=4.5 px, take the per-field max, keep within-footprint top-decile cells, and sum field indicators to a concordance count C in 0..6; set prior p = (C/6)^2 multiplied by a smooth repulsion ramp R = clip((dist_to_visible_catalogue_px - 2)/3, 0, 1) that zeroes emission within 2 px of the MAPPED catalogue (known-fault pixels are masked from official scoring, so budget must concentrate off-catalogue) and ramps to full weight by 5 px; emit a fixed budget of ~39,000 unit-mass dots by descending expected kernel credit E[k] = p * k300 with greedy 300 m triangular-kernel coverage credit (shared gems57.emit greedy allocator, no private fork); write a float32 single-band GeoTIFF with value 1.0 at dots, 0.0 everywhere else inside the footprint and 0.0 outside (all-finite, no NaN anywhere), matching the pinned sample grid. All catalogue-derived geometry (the repulsion distance field) is rebuilt from visible faults only inside each buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover fold; concordance uses no catalogue at all.

holdout.blocking: four spatial quadrants; whole segments <=12 px with 3 px buffer; domain erode 12 px
holdout.caveat: Owner-mirror labels.tif is byte-identical to existing_faults.tif (sha256 7ba308cc...), so hide-and-recover truth IS the mapped catalogue. Official scoring masks mapped faults, therefore this holdout measures the INVERSE of the leaderboard task for off-catalogue emitters. HOLDOUT-DTI is reported with that caveat and never promoted to a leaderboard projection.
